# Brainware University - Department of Computational Sciences (CSS)

## Faculty & Administration
- Head of Department (HOD): Dr. Jayanta Aich
- Professor: Dr. Anirban Roy (Specialization: Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence)
- Assistant Professor: Prof. Sanchari Saha (Specialization: Computer Networks, Data Structures)
- Department Contact Email: css@brainwareuniversity.ac.in
- Office Location: Tech Building, 3rd Floor, Room 304

## Academic Programs & Fee Structure
- BCA (Bachelor of Computer Applications): 3 Years (6 Semesters), Fee: ₹65,000 per semester.
- B.Tech in CSE (Computer Science & Engineering): 4 Years (8 Semesters), Fee: ₹95,000 per semester.
- MCA (Master of Computer Applications): 2 Years (4 Semesters), Fee: ₹75,000 per semester.

## Hostel & Campus Facilities
- Boys' Hostel (AC Triple Sharing): ₹42,000 per semester including mess.
- Girls' Hostel (AC Triple Sharing): ₹42,000 per semester including mess.
- Non-AC Double Sharing: ₹35,000 per semester.
- Campus Emergency Helpdesk: +91 98765 43210 (24x7 Security & Medical).

## Admission Criteria & Dates
- Eligibility: Minimum 50% in Class 12 with Mathematics/Computer Science.
- Admission Session: July - August 2026.
